resources.string: Twig here, pocket edition! Hand me a video and I\'ll rip out every sneaky little tag that snitches on where, when and with what you filmed it. And nothing leaves your phone. I don\'t even HAVE internet. Great gears, the privacy!
Level 1 · metadata scrub (lossless, no re-encode) + hidden-tone check. Audio cleaning lives in desktop Scrubgnome.
